/**
 * Adds numbers.
 * @param {number} a first
 * @param {Point|Vector} b second
 * @param {Array<Shape>} a again
 * @returns {Promise<Result>}
 */
export function add(a, b = DEFAULT, ...rest) {
  const local = a + b;
  return helper(local, rest, Point, Shape);
}

export const DEFAULT = 1, OTHER = DEFAULT + 1;
export let counter = 0;
var legacy = function () { return add(1, 2); };

function helper(x) { return x; }

export default helper;
export { helper as aid, legacy };
export * from './shapes';
export { Circle as Round } from './shapes';
